# AgiBot AimDK Python protocol wheel

`a3_aimdk-3.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` comes from the official AgiBot A3 Ultra
AimDK v3.2 development package (`prebuilt/`). It is stored in the project COS
bucket and downloaded into the driver image during the Docker build, so the
repository does not carry the binary and runtime protobuf schemas do not
depend on a development-kit mount.
